    theta = normalize_angle(sandbox.get_pole_angle())
    omega = sandbox.get_pole_angular_velocity()
    
    # Get cart state
    x = sandbox.get_cart_position()
    v = sandbox.get_cart_velocity()
    
    # Track center and safe zone parameters
    target_x = sandbox.TRACK_CENTER_X
    safe_half_range = sandbox.SAFE_HALF_RANGE
    
    # Low-pass filtering for sensor delay mitigation
    # Initialize filter states if not already present

        agent_action.omega_filtered = omega

    agent_action.omega_filtered = ALPHA * omega + (1 - ALPHA) * agent_action.omega_filtered
    
    # Calculate control force with reduced gains
    theta_error = agent_action.theta_filtered
    omega_error = agent_action.omega_filtered
    x_error = x - target_x

    # Compute control force (with safety limits)

    # Soft constraint: prevent excessive force when near track limits
